text: Exhibition Place has an agreement with HM Cash Inc. ("HM Cash") for the provision of Automated Teller Machines on an "Official/Preferred Supplier" basis within the Enercare Centre and Beanfield Centre for a four year term expiring March 31, 2020. On September 20, 2018, Exhibition Place received a letter from HM Cash advising that it has entered into an agreement to assign the above contract to Access Cash General Partnership ("Access") which transaction closed on August 31, 2018. As set out in the ATM Agreement such assignment requires the consent of the Board. This report recommends that the Board consent to an assignment to Access of the existing agreement between HM Cash and the Board dated April 1, 2016 (the “ATM Agreement”).

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Consented to the assignment of the ATM Agreement from HM Cash Inc. to Access Cash General Partnership on terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor.
